line: A model opens to every developer, Seoul's market breaks its September high by 20 %, Brussels sends questions to two AI labs: a newsroom bulletin with a virtual studio, numbered bumpers and a strap that never leaves.
line_cn: 一个模型全面开放，首尔股市较 9 月高点跌破两成，布鲁塞尔向两家 AI 实验室发出问询：虚拟演播室、条目 bumper、一直在底部的条带，一档电视新闻的包装系统。
